_comment: Impossible OS user-mode perf baselines. Populated by test_perf_*.exe binaries emitting [PERF] <metric>=<value_ns> lines (see user/include/test.h UTEST_PERF). Today the consumer is the test itself -- binaries hardcode thresholds via UTEST_ASSERT. A future libc JSON helper (TODO-04 §8 deferred) will read this file and let the launcher auto-FAIL on drift > tolerance. Until then, this file is a structured record of expected values for trend analysis in CI and on bare metal.

tcg._comment: QEMU TCG: slowest runner, WSL2 default. Pure x86 emulation, no hardware assist.

kvm._comment: QEMU KVM: hardware-accelerated Linux host. ~2s boot in smoke-test.sh.

whpx._comment: QEMU WHPX: Windows Hypervisor Platform, primary validation target.

sys_yield_ns._description: INT 0x80 round-trip to SYS_YIELD handler (returns 0); median of 16 samples. APPROXIMATE -- uses a fixed 2 GHz TSC assumption, so reported ns scales with (real_tsc_hz / 2e9). For a TSC-Hz-independent gate, see sys_yield_cycles.

sys_yield_cycles._description: Raw TSC cycle count for the sys_yield round-trip; median of 16 samples. TSC-Hz-independent (asserted by test_perf_syscall.exe via CYCLE_CEILING). Primary gate so > 2 GHz CPUs do not fail on the inflated ns report.
